biggest_catch: Sitters set their own rates, so there is no official fixed worker pay - the only official figure is a UK example (£25/night net), and the USD value depends on an unofficial conversion.
catches: No official fixed worker pay: sitters set their own rates; the £25/night figure is an official example, not a rate.
Holidog takes a 15% commission on confirmed bookings.
The official example is quoted in GBP for the UK market; USD values require an unofficial FX conversion.
No official figures exist for active care time per boarding night.
No guaranteed bookings - earnings depend on winning pet owners in a crowded local marketplace.

c1.evidence: holidog.com official shows a £25/night net example after 15% commission - but sitters set their own rates, so this is an example, not a fixed worker pay figure.

c2.evidence: holidog.com official: 'Automatic payouts - After the service, your payout after 15% commission lands in your account within 48 hours.'

c3.evidence: No upfront fee documented; signup is free per official page.

c4.evidence: Official timing exists, but no official fixed USD worker pay and no official active-time figures.

eligibility: 18+; genuine animal lover; free signup; complete sitter profile (services, rates, availability).
maximize: Holidog is rejected here because sitters set their own rates - there is no official fixed worker pay to verify, and the GBP example cannot convert to an official USD figure. Its official 48-hour automatic payouts and 15% commission are documented; if you use it anyway, list all four services, price near the local average Holidog shows, and collect reviews on every stay.
notes: Official: Holidog UK become-sitter page (GBP 25/night net example after 15% commission, 15% commission, 48-hour automatic payouts, free signup). Rejected: sitters set their own rates (no fixed official worker pay, same basis as the Superprof rejection), the only official figure is a GBP example requiring an unofficial conversion, and no official active-time figures exist.
numeric_basis: backfill: Rejected - sitters set own rates; only official figure is a GBP example; no official active-time figures
payout_quote: Official example only: boarding one dog at your place, GBP 25/night net estimate after 15% commission on confirmed bookings. Sitters set their own rates; this is an official example, not a fixed rate, and no official USD figure exists.
payout_value_note: Rejected - no official fixed USD worker pay (sitters set own rates; GBP example only)

s6.note: Fails: no official fixed worker pay (self-set rates) and no official active-time figures.

steps: Sign up free as a pet sitter on Holidog and build your profile with photos.
Set your rates and availability for boarding, house sitting, cat visits, or dog walking.
Accept booking requests from pet owners and message them through the platform.
Complete the service; your payout (after 15% commission) lands automatically within 48 hours.
timing: Official: 'Automatic payouts - After the service, your payout after 15% commission lands in your account within 48 hours.'
